### Version Checks (indicate both or one)

- [ ] I have confirmed this bug exists on the lastest [release](https://github.com/pypsa/pypsa/releases) of PyPSA.

- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the current [`master`](https://github.com/pypsa/pypsa/tree/master) branch of PyPSA.


### Issue Description

When installing the master branch (`pip install git+https://github.com/PyPSA/PyPSA.git@master`) and using `n.copy()`, I'm getting the following warnings:

> WARNING:pypsa.io:The following Generator have buses which are not defined:
> 
> WARNING:pypsa.io:The following Line have buses which are not defined:
> 
> WARNING:pypsa.io:The following Load have buses which are not defined:
> 
> WARNING:pypsa.io:The following StorageUnit have buses which are not defined:

followed by a list of _all_ generators, lines, loads, storage units, respectively

Sometimes links appear, too. My network does not contain stores.  Not sure what's the problem here.

This didn't appear in v0.28.0 (when reverting back with `pip install pypsa==v0.28.0`, everything seems to work as intended - no warnings appear).

Not sure what's the issue, optimization of networks seems work, and all buses seem to exist as intended. The warning is just a bit misleading (and spams the terminal if called often)

### Reproducible Example

```python
import pypsa
n = pypsa.examples.scigrid_de()
n.copy()
```


### Expected Behavior

_No response_
